What's going on with your Chime account?New!Chime account not accessibleVerification code not receivedSoftware technician: Lakshman WogmodeHi! Welcome to JustAnswer. My name is *****. It seems you're experiencing issues accessing your Chime account and are repeatedly receiving the same code. Is that correct?Could you inform me if you have attempted to reset your password using an alternative verification method?I'm sorry to hear you're experiencing issues with your Chime account; that must be frustrating! Here are a few steps you can try to resolve the problem:1. Update Phone Number: If you no longer have access to the phone number associated with your Chime account, you can update it. On the verification screen, tap "Need help?" and select "Update phone number."Link >https://help.chime.com/hc/en-us/articles/4406299339671-Why-can-t-I-log-in-to-my-account2. Reset Password: If you've forgotten your password, you can reset it by visiting the Chime website and clicking on "Forgot Password."3. Contact Chime Support: If the above steps don't work, you may need to reach out to Chime customer support directly.4. Check for Account Holds: Sometimes, Chime places a temporary hold on accounts due to unusual activity. If this occurs, contacting Chime support can help resolve the issue.I hope one of these steps helps you regain access to your account.
